changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS log.rouming_log ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, contract_id UUID, contract_no TEXT, factura_no TEXT, seller_tin TEXT, buyer_tin TEXT, status TEXT, error_message TEXT, request TEXT, response TEXT, request_time TIMESTAMP, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rouming_log_created ON log.rouming_log (created_date DESC);
